title: Morroniside, a novel GATA3 binding molecule, inhibits hepatic stellate cells activation by enhancing lysosomal acid lipase expression.
authors: An, Lin; Zhang, Mi; Lin, Yuefang; Jiang, Ting; Xu, Keyang; Xiao, Shilin; Cai, Liming; Kwan, Hiu Yee; Liu, Zhongqiu; Su, Tao
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究莫诺苷通过结合GATA3转录因子调控LAL表达抑制肝星状细胞活化，涉及TF-DNA结合位点预测与MD模拟，但核心是药物分子-蛋白互作而非TF-DNA结合机制建模，方法深度有限。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Liver fibrosis can be easily developed into irreversible liver cirrhosis or even liver cancer. Lysosomal acid lipase (LAL), encoded by the lipase A (Lipa) gene, is a critical enzyme involved in liver fibrosis development. Morroniside, an iridoid glycoside isolated from Cornus officinalis Sieb. et Zucc., exerts hepatic protective effects. However, the mechanism of action underling the anti-liver fibrosis effects of morroniside have not been fully elucidated. PURPOSE: To explore whether Lipa served as a biomarker for liver fibrosis and investigate the anti-liver fibrosis effects of morroniside and the underlying action mechanism in liver fibrosis cell models. METHODS: LAL expression was examined in the liver tissues of CCl(4) and high-fat diet (HFD)-induced liver fibrosis animal models. alpha-smooth muscle actin (alpha-SMA) level, collagen and GATA family expressions were analyzed by Real-time PCR and Western blot. Putative transcription factor binding sites in the DNA sequences of Lipa was identified by PROMO-ALGGEN v8.3 online software and ENCODE ChIP-Seq Significance Tool. MD simulation was performed to explore the protein-ligand interaction. RESULTS: We found that the expression of hepatic LAL is lower in the liver fibrosis animal models than the control models. The reduced LAL expression is associated with HSCs activation, suggesting LAL is novel liver fibrosis biomarker. More importantly, our data showed that morroniside exerts anti-liver fibrosis effects in vitro. Mechanistic studies reveal that it binds to the hydrophobic sites of GATA3 and also reduces GATA3 expression, which increases LAL expression. CONCLUSIONS: This study, for the first time, suggests LAL is a novel biomarker for liver fibrosis. Besides, morroniside exerts its anti-liver fibrosis effects by targeting GATA3 and LAL and hence inhibits HSC activation. These findings provide strong scientific evidence to support the development of morroniside as novel alternative or complementary therapeutics for liver injury prevention and treatment.
abstract_zh: 背景：肝纤维化易发展为不可逆的肝硬化甚至肝癌。溶酶体酸性脂肪酶（LAL），由脂肪酶A（Lipa）基因编码，是参与肝纤维化发展的关键酶。莫诺苷，一种从山茱萸（Cornus officinalis Sieb. et Zucc.）中分离出的环烯醚萜苷，具有肝脏保护作用。然而，莫诺苷抗肝纤维化效应的作用机制尚未完全阐明。目的：探讨Lipa是否作为肝纤维化的生物标志物，并研究莫诺苷在肝纤维化细胞模型中的抗肝纤维化效应及其潜在作用机制。方法：检测CCl(4)和高脂饮食（HFD）诱导的肝纤维化动物模型肝组织中LAL的表达。通过实时PCR和Western blot分析α-平滑肌肌动蛋白（alpha-SMA）水平、胶原蛋白及GATA家族表达。利用PROMO-ALGGEN v8.3在线软件和ENCODE ChIP-Seq显著性工具识别Lipa DNA序列中的推定转录因子结合位点。进行分子动力学（MD）模拟以探索蛋白质-配体相互作用。结果：我们发现，肝纤维化动物模型中肝脏LAL的表达低于对照组模型。LAL表达的降低与肝星状细胞（HSCs）活化相关，表明LAL是一种新型肝纤维化生物标志物。更重要的是，我们的数据显示莫诺苷在体外发挥抗肝纤维化效应。机制研究表明，莫诺苷结合GATA3的疏水位点并降低GATA3表达，从而增加LAL表达。结论：本研究首次表明LAL是肝纤维化的新型生物标志物。此外，莫诺苷通过靶向GATA3和LAL发挥抗肝纤维化效应，从而抑制HSC活化。这些发现为莫诺苷作为肝损伤预防和治疗的新型替代或补充疗法的发展提供了强有力的科学证据。
